content_units: Prague Trip Fit for 10–14 Sep 2026
For your constraints,   Flight A is the best option  . It is the cheapest valid choice, stays under budget, avoids overnight travel, and gets you into Prague well before 20:00.
Ranked Transport Options
Option   Outbound   Return   Total Trip Cost   Fits Constraints   Why it ranks here
Flight A   07:10–10:00   18:20–21:15     194 EUR       Yes     Lowest total cost among valid options; simple nonstop-style timing; arrival before 20:00
Flight B   15:40–18:35   06:30–09:25     188 EUR flight + 18 EUR bus = 206 EUR       Yes     Still under budget and valid, but earlier return is less convenient and added bus cost/step
Train+flight   08:00–14:10   12:00–19:30     215 EUR       Yes     Valid and daytime-friendly, but costs more and takes much longer than Flight A
Why Flight A wins
-   Best value:   95 EUR + 99 EUR =   194 EUR total
-   Budget-safe:   leaves   66 EUR   under your   260 EUR   transport cap
-   No overnight travel:   both legs are daytime
-   Arrival rule met:   outbound arrival is   10:00 local time  , comfortably before 20:00
-   Best trip shape for 4 days:   early outbound gives you nearly a full first day in Prague
Option-by-option notes
Option 1:   Flight A     Best overall balance of price, convenience, and usable trip time     194 EUR total
- Strongest match for your priorities.
- Morning departure maximizes sightseeing time on 10 Sep.
- Return is evening, so you also keep most of 14 Sep.
Option 2:   Flight B     Slightly more expensive once transfer cost is included, with a less comfortable return schedule     206 EUR total
- Valid under all stated constraints.
- Outbound arrival at 18:35 is still acceptable.
- Main drawback is the   06:30 return  , which usually means a very early airport start.
Option 3:   Train+flight     Works, but slower and pricier without giving a clear benefit     215 EUR total
- Also under budget and daytime-only.
- Long travel time reduces overall trip efficiency.
- Good backup only if you prefer a later return arrival or need non-flight flexibility on one leg.
Constraint Check
-   Route:   Madrid → Prague → Madrid
-   Passengers:   1 adult
-   Carry-on only:   all listed options remain within your stated transport budget
-   Budget under 260 EUR:   all 3 qualify
-   No overnight travel:   all 3 qualify
-   Arrival before 20:00 local time:   all outbound options qualify
